questions.q: The correct order of 2<sup>nd</sup> ionization energy for the elements carbon, nitrogen, oxygen and fluorine is
questions.solution:
The second ionisation energy means the energy required to remove the electron from the corresponding monovalent cation of the respective atom. For IE2, electronic. Configuration of C+,N+,O+ and F+ -ions which are as follows.

C+=2s2,2p1

N+=2s2,2p2

O+=2s2,2p3

F+=2s2,2p4

∵ O+ is half - filed configuration, obviously it is most stable and greater ionization energy than F+ as well as

N+ . The ionisation energy of an element depends upon its size as. IE∝ 1 Size of atom/ ion smaller the atom/ion,

larger mill be IE.

Hence, correct order will be, O>F>N>C
